name: Moneta
oneLiner: USDM is Moneta's dollar stablecoin on Cardano, issued through U.S. and EEA routes with NBX EMI-license and MiCA-pending framing.
collateral: USD bank deposits and money market funds managed by Fidelity and Western Asset Management (Moneta/USA issuance) and Sparebanken Norge / Amundi USD MM fund (NBX/EEA issuance), held in segregated reserve accounts
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Moneta (USA) or NBX (EEA); KYC required; Charli3 oracle verifies reserve backing on-chain before each mint on Cardano

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Moneta's official fundamentals notice states that USDM went live on Cardano mainnet for institutional partners on March 16, 2024 and identifies the policy ID that matches the tracked asset. Its direct 1:1 fiat-reserve issuance and redemption design supports the fiat-cash archetype.

sources.label: Moneta USDM fundamentals and mainnet launch

proofOfReserves.provider: Charli3 daily reserve verification feed (attribution confirmed via docs, but the portal.charli3.io endpoint rejects non-browser TLS handshakes on repeated checks and the only archive capture is a 2024 unrendered shell - statically unverifiable)

jurisdiction.license: FinCEN MSB #31000327040139 / E-money institution; MiCA EMT authorization pending

notices.title: Implementation date not publicly established
notices.message: Safety Score V9 implementation-date review on 2026-07-14 checked the current Moneta, NBX, Cardano, and USDM deployment materials but found no reliable dated launch or implementation event for the scored USDM implementation; no date is inferred.
